classifications.reasoning: The rule detects Stratum protocol JSON-RPC requests for Bitcoin mining (mining.extranonce.subscribe), which directly indicates unauthorized cryptomining activity hijacking compute resources.
The rule matches a buffer overflow exploit attempt against the TP-Link TDDP network service (SET_CONFIG type), observable as exploitation of a remote service on a network device.
The rule identifies HTTP-delivered exploit code targeting CVE-2016-9079 (Firefox use-after-free), which is client-side exploitation triggered by user browsing.
Same CVE-2016-9079 Firefox exploit as sid 40888 but with a different SVG animation payload signature; still client-side exploitation via web content.
The rule detects TDDP Get_config requests that leak device configuration data, directly mapping to network device configuration dump reconnaissance.
The rule flags a static byte pattern in HTTP traffic associated with Linux.DDoS.D93 malware C2, indicating command-and-control over web protocols.
The rule detects requests to /apply_noauth.cgi on Netgear routers, an authentication bypass vulnerability in a public-facing web application.
The rule matches a stack buffer overflow exploit attempt against the hidden_lang_avi parameter in a Netgear router web interface, a public-facing application.
The rule identifies characteristic HTTP headers and URI patterns (/admin.php?f=) used by Locky ransomware for C2 communication over web protocols.
Another Locky C2 signature detecting specific HTTP parameters (x-requested-with, Referer) used for command-and-control over HTTP.
The rule matches HTTP traffic patterns (User-Agent HttpEngine, .do endpoints) associated with Android Sysch trojan C2 over web protocols.
Additional Sysch trojan C2 signature detecting custom HTTP headers (GZIPOK, CompGZ, ReqType) and .do endpoints for command-and-control.
The rule detects command injection attempts via the arg parameter in Western Digital MyCloud's google_analytics.php, exploiting a public-facing web application (CVE-2016-10108).
Variant of the same MyCloud command injection exploit targeting URL-encoded shell metacharacters (%26) in the arg parameter.
Broader regex detection of shell metacharacters in the arg parameter for MyCloud command injection, same CVE-2016-10108 exploitation.
Detects command injection via multipart Content-Disposition arg parameter in MyCloud, another vector for CVE-2016-10108 exploitation.
The rule identifies a static binary registration message (0x41 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x83) used by NetWiredRC trojan over raw TCP, a non-application-layer C2 protocol.
Detects NetWiredRC 'check logs' command message (0x38 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x85) in the same custom TCP protocol.
Detects NetWiredRC keepalive message (0x01 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x81) in the custom binary C2 protocol.
The rule only detects legitimate Cisco Webex plugin usage (policy violation), not an adversary technique; no ATT&CK mapping applies.
Flags a known malicious User-Agent string ('Useragents') in HTTP traffic, an indicator of C2 over web protocols, though the signature is generic.
Detects specific multipart form-data fields (uid, uname, cname, ltime) used by X-Mas ransomware for HTTP C2 check-ins.
The rule matches a buffer overflow exploit attempt against QNAP NAS cgi.cgi with long u/p parameters, targeting a public-facing web application.
Detects WordPress REST API authentication bypass via non-numeric 'id' parameter (CVE-2017-5487), exploiting a public-facing web application.
Duplicate signature for the same WordPress REST API authentication bypass vulnerability as sid 41495.
